title: AnalyticsCommand
responsibility: Registers local analytics query, CPU snapshot, and retention-prune commands with their command-line options.

inputs.name: registerAnalyticsCommand.program
inputs.description: Commander program that receives the analytics command tree.

outputs.name: registerAnalyticsCommand
outputs.description: Registers CPU, prune, summary, loops, jev, models, tasks, benchmarks, events, import, and export subcommands; prune defaults to 90 days and deletes only with --apply.
